title: Smoky Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting vegan stew made with smoky lentils and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Lentils
ingredients.notes: Any type of lentil works well for this recipe.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced or crushed, as you like.

ingredients.name: Smoky Paprika
ingredients.notes: Adds a nice smoky depth to the stew.

ingredients.name: Greek Tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Diced or crushed, whichever suits your taste.

ingredients.name: Vegetable Broth
ingredients.notes: Low-sodium or homemade, if you prefer.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of your favorite spices, or a combination of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon.

instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the smoky paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomato paste, Greek tomatoes, and vegetable broth.
Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season with aromatic spices to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
